service.name: Live music for a birthday party
service.serviceType: A band, a jazz duo, a singer with a guitar or a Spanish guitarist for 30th, 40th, 50th and 60th birthday parties and surprise parties
service.description: Live music for a milestone birthday party across Denver and the Front Range: a trio or quartet for the 30th and 40th that dance, a jazz duo at 65 to 72 dBA under the 50th's dinner and toasts, a solo musician or a duo for the 60th and past it, a singer who learns the birthday song the guest of honour actually wants, at home, at a club or in a private dining space, with an announcement microphone for the toasts and one personal contact.

faqs.q: Can we hire a band for a birthday party?
faqs.a: Yes, and the size follows the number on the cake. A 30th or a 40th that ends on a dance floor books a trio of guitar, bass and drums or a quartet; a 50th that is a dinner with a toast in it books a jazz duo at 65 to 72 dBA at the nearest table; a 60th and past it books one musician or a duo from arrival through dessert. It's one contract with one personal contact, sound support that's the right size for the space, and an announcement microphone for the toasts.

faqs.q: What size band for a 40th birthday party?
faqs.a: A trio or a quartet. A 40th is usually two parties in one evening, a seated dinner and then a floor, and a trio plays the dinner at conversation volume and fills the floor afterward without a stage, in 12 by 8 feet on one dedicated circuit. A quartet, in 14 by 10 feet on two circuits, is the size for a club or a venue past a hundred guests, and the DJ can carry the late end through the same sound system.

faqs.q: How do you handle a surprise birthday party?
faqs.a: The same way a proposal is handled. The musicians are set up early and playing at conversation volume, so the place looks like it simply has live music that night, and the guest of honour's song starts on a cue you and the band agree beforehand, a nod from the host or a text from the door. The proposals and surprise songs page covers the cue and the learned song, and the first learned song is included in every booking.

faqs.q: Can the band play the birthday person's favourite songs?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us the name, the number and a few of the songs, and the set is built from the years the guest of honour actually cares about rather than from a generic list. The first learned song is included in every booking and each one after it is its own line on the quote, and the whole song list is searchable on the repertoire page.

faqs.q: What are birthday party entertainment ideas for adults?
faqs.a: A band for the floor after dinner, the soul and R&B band or the funk band for a crowd that grew up on those records; live band karaoke for the 40th where the friends want the mic; a singer with a guitar who learns the one song; a Spanish guitarist under a long family dinner for the 60th; a Beatles sing-along the grandchildren can join at the 70th and 80th; and a jazz duo silent for the toasts and back the moment the glass goes down.

faqs.q: How much do musicians charge for a birthday party?
faqs.a: The pricing page sets out what live music costs in this market, figure by figure with the source each one came from, and the cost guide has the Colorado figures for each kind of night. Send the date, the place, the number and roughly who is coming, and we'll come back with a configuration and a price for the night.

faqs.q: Can a band play a birthday party at home?
faqs.a: Yes. A solo musician takes 6 by 4 feet on one dedicated circuit, a duo 8 by 6 on one, a trio 12 by 8 on one, in the corner the party naturally faces, and every size plays dinner at 65 to 72 dBA at the nearest table. Outdoors it plays on a covered, level and dry spot with power run to it, and whatever number the HOA or the neighbourhood puts on evening sound goes into the contract.
